Wail hai un ke liye jo naap tol mein kami karne waale hain
Yeh jab logon se naap kar lete hain to poora maal le lete hain
Aur jab un ke liye naapte ya tolte hain to kam kar dete hain
Kya inhein yeh khayaal nahin hai ke yeh ek roz dobaara uthaaye jaane waale hain
Bade sakht din mein
Jis din sab Rabb-ul-Aalameen ki baargaah mein haazir honge
Yaad rakho ke badkaaron ka naama-e-aamaal Sijjeen mein hoga
Aur tum kya jaano ke Sijjeen kya hai
Ek likha hua daftar hai
Aaj ke din un jhutlaane waalon ke liye barbaadi hai
Jo log roz-e-jaza ka inkaar karte hain
Aur us ka inkaar sirf wahi karte hain jo hadd se guzar jaane waale gunahgaar hain
Jab un ke saamne aayaat ki tilaawat ki jaati hai to kehte hain ke yeh to puraane afsaane hain
Nahin nahin, balke un ke dilon par un ke aamaal ka zang lag gaya hai
Yaad rakho inhein roz-e-qiyaamat Parwardigar ki rehmat se mahjoob kar diya jaaega
Phir us ke baad yeh Jahannam mein jhonke jaane waale hain
Phir un se kaha jaaega ke yahi woh hai jis ka tum inkaar kar rahe the
Yaad rakho ke nek kirdaar afraad ka naama-e-aamaal Illiyyeen mein hoga
Aur tum kya jaano ke Illiyyeen kya hai
Ek likha hua daftar hai
Jis ke gawaah malaaika-e-muqarrabeen hain
Beshak nek log ne'maton mein honge
Takhton par baithe hue nazaare kar rahe honge
Tum un ke chehron par ne'mat ki shaadaabi ka mushaahida karoge
Inhein sar-ba-mohr khaalis sharaab se seeraab kiya jaaega
Jis ki mohr mushk ki hogi, aur aisi cheezon mein shauq karne waalon ko aapas mein sabqat aur raghbat karni chaahiye
Is sharaab mein Tasneem ke paani ki aamezish hogi
Yeh ek chashma hai jis se muqarrab-e-baargaah bande paani peete hain
Beshak yeh mujrimeen saahibaan-e-imaan ka mazaaq udaaya karte the
Aur jab woh un ke paas se guzarte the to ishaare kinaaye karte the
Aur jab apne ahl ki taraf palat kar aate the to khush o khurram hote the
Aur jab momineen ko dekhte to kehte the ke yeh sab asli gumraah hain
Haalaanke inhein un ka nigraan bana kar nahin bheja gaya tha
To aaj imaan laane waale bhi kuffaar ka mazhaka udaayenge
Takhton par baithe hue dekh rahe honge
Ab to kuffaar ko un ke aamaal ka poora poora badla mil raha hai
